headline.en: Flick has used three players at left-back in two Liga games
headline.es: Flick ha usado a tres laterales zurdos en dos partidos de Liga

summary.en: Flick has used three players at left-back across the first two Liga matches. Xavi Espart started at Elche and mixed the Athletic night between the flank and midfield. Cancelo came on late. Balde is back in the squad and has not started. The Rayo match is the next decision.
summary.es: Tres nombres en dos partidos. Espart salio en Elche. Cancelo entro tarde. Balde no ha sido titular. El Rayo es la siguiente decision.

body.en: Left-back is where Flick's squad-building is most visible. He promoted Espart, registered Cancelo, and kept Balde after a public week that could have ended in a sale. That is three solutions to one problem. Espart gives him a Masia profile who understands the interior. Cancelo gives him a player who has won in the job at a high level. Balde gives him the recovery speed if Flick decides the other two are too conservative against a transition side. Rayo attack that channel. The selection on Monday will say which risk Flick prefers, not which player has won the job for the season. Writing a winner after two matches is how you get the next week wrong. The honest card is the contest itself. Three names, one start, a low block arriving on Monday, and a European list nine days later. That is enough without turning it into a character study.

headline.en: After Feyenoord, Barcelona visit Galatasaray and Paris Saint-Germain in October
headline.es: Despues del Feyenoord, el Barca visita a Galatasaray y al PSG en octubre

summary.en: After Feyenoord, Barcelona go to Galatasaray and Paris Saint-Germain in consecutive away weeks in October, then host Aston Villa in November and Manchester City in December. SPORT described that stretch as the difficult block. The extra bodies signed this summer are for those matches, not for Rayo on Monday.
summary.es: Despues del Feyenoord llegan Galatasaray y el PSG fuera en octubre, Villa en noviembre y City en diciembre. SPORT marco ese tramo como el bloque dificil.

body.en: League-phase tables punish thin squads more than they punish a clumsy first night. Feyenoord at home is the night the calendar allows Flick to rotate if Liga minutes are heavy. The October double away is the opposite. Paris will not give Barcelona the spaces Athletic left. Galatasaray away is a travel-and-control problem. City at Camp Nou in December is the fixture that will be used to judge whether Gordon, Adeyemi and Rodri were worth the 1:1 spend. Writing those games now is not drama. It is why the club signed four senior players before the list was even timed. Eric Garcia already misses the first night. Gavi and Rodri are being managed. Yamal's minutes are climbing. That is the real UCL preview. The opponent list is public. The available bodies are not. If October arrives with the same midfield shortness Saturday showed, the press Flick has recovered will look like the injuries from his first autumn.

headline.en: Barcelona are selling academy players who are not in Flick's starting side
headline.es: El Barca vende canteranos que no estan en el once de Flick

summary.en: MARCA reported Toni Fernandez close to five million euros to Venezia and Alvaro Cortes at 3.5 million to Antwerp. Culemania kept Fernandez nearer four million with a buy-back. Hector Fort already left in the same way. Deco is raising cash and keeping a future option.
summary.es: MARCA situo a Fernandez cerca de cinco millones y a Cortes en 3,5. Culemania dejo a Fernandez cerca de cuatro con recompra. Fort ya salio igual.

body.en: Every summer Barcelona are accused of either blocking the academy or giving it away. This week is the duller version. Fort, Cortes and Fernandez were not going to start ahead of Yamal, Raphinha, Gordon or the centre-back pair Flick already trusts. Selling them with a buy-back is how the club keeps a claim on a future price while booking income now. If one of them explodes in Italy or Belgium, the clause is the story in two years. If they do not, the ratio still closed in August. That is the deal Deco is running, and it only works if the fees actually land before the next registration deadline. Pair it with Espart's promotion and the picture is consistent. The players Flick will use move onto the first-team sheet. The players he will not use are sold with a string attached. Calling that a betrayal of La Masia skips the part where the 1:1 rule is what allowed Gordon and Rodri to be listed at all.
